final: WITH account_counts AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM "order" GROUP BY account_id), total AS (SELECT SUM(order_count) AS total_count FROM account_counts), shares AS (SELECT account_id, order_count, order_count * 1.0 / total_count AS share FROM account_counts CROSS JOIN total WHERE total_count IS NOT NULL), mean_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM shares) SELECT SUM(order_count), AVG(share), AVG(share - value) FROM shares CROSS JOIN mean_share WHERE value IS NOT NULL AND share > value
